Hi all,

Following up on Monica's earlier heads-up that she'll be returning from parental leave at the start of February. Monica and I discussed a phased return that balances her recovery and caregiving needs with coverage for the team. I wanted to put a concrete proposal in one place so HR and People Ops can advise on next steps/approvals.

Summary of proposal (attached: monica_medical_note.pdf, proposed_coverage_matrix.xlsx):
- Start date: 2026-02-01
- Weeks 1-4: 60% schedule (3x6-hour days) with defined core overlap 11:00-15:00 PT
- Weeks 5-8: 80% schedule (4x7-hour days) leading to full-time at week 9
- Primary responsibilities during ramp: ownership of priors A/B/C, pairing on larger features, no on-call for first 8 weeks
- Coverage: temporary reallocation of two active tickets to Lauren and one sprint-level mentor assigned (see coverage matrix)

Monica: you confirmed this feels feasible in our sync last week; flag if I mis-stated anything.

HR/People: please confirm what formal documentation you need (medical note, signed return agreement, DocuSign form) and whether there are any benefits/eligibility implications for a partial-week schedule.

I'll coordinate with Eng leads to update sprint commitments once we have sign-off.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
